blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Publish, on this desk
blocks.body:
**Publish** here means: turn the booklet into a site or a PDF.

A **transformation scenario** is a saved recipe: which booklet, which engine, which output folder.

**DITA-OT** is the engine that turns the booklet into a site or a PDF. You do not start it by hand. The recipe starts it.

**Configure Transformation Scenario** → filter **DITA Map**. Pick the type. Set **output** outside source (for example `out/`).

If yesterday’s switch file belongs on this output, attach it here too. Author preview and publish filters are different attachments.

The recipe named **WebHelp Responsive** makes a clickable draft site. You will run it tomorrow.

Do not run it yet unless you want a peek.

lessons.title: Name the recipe, pick the output folder

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Output is set to the source topics/ folder, or you published a single page when you meant the booklet, or you skipped Configure and ran a mystery default.

Expected: Recipe named and attached to the booklet. Output folder outside source. Switch-file field noted. Nothing published yet :  or a clean first run if you did run it.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Set kitepump.ditamap as the root map. Open DITA Maps Manager.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Configure Transformation Scenario (toolbar or Document > Transformation :  verify the label). Filter ‘DITA Map’.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Select DITA Map WebHelp Responsive. That is a clickable draft site. Do not run it yet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Set the output folder to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6/out-webhelp/ :  outside the source tree. If the default is inside maps/, change it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: If the recipe has a field for a switch file, attach novice.ditaval. Write whether you attached it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Save the recipe on the map if your version stores it. Write the recipe name in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6/scenario-name.txt.

blocks.summary: Recipe named and attached to the booklet. Output folder outside source. Switch-file field noted. Nothing published yet :  or a clean first run if you did run it.
